AUTHOR: Shi, XH; Czerniawski, R; Tanwari, K; Furdyna, A; Krepski, T
TITLE: Pomerania Fish: A dataset for fishes across Pomerania freshwater waterbodies in-situ environments
REGION: Pomerania rivers (Teufelsgraben, Gowienica, Ina, Drawa, Płociczna, Korytnica), Poland/Germany
SPECIES: Salmo trutta m. trutta (male/female), S. t. m. fario (adult/juvenile), Salmoninae juvenile, Thymallus thymallus, Perca fluviatilis, Rutilus rutilus, Oncorhynchus mykiss, Leuciscus idus
DATA: Own PomerFish dataset (GoPro Hero 5, 2015-2024): PomerFishObj 14,989 images; PomerFishSeg 1,115 images; from 22 episodes / 37 video segments
V_EV: Dataset annotations: 'Frames with poor visibility or uncertain species identification were excluded from the annotation process.'
D_EV: Object detection: 'we split the PomerFishObj dataset into training (80%) and validation (20%) sets for each class based on their number of instances (Table 2)'
R_EV: Technical Validation: evaluation only on the 20% validation split of PomerFish ('the YOLOv5 model, when applied to our dataset')
E_EV: Table 4: only 'F1, Recall, Precision, mAP_0.5, mAP_0.5:0.95' and segmentation 'Mean IoU', 'Accuracy'
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95; mean IoU, pixel accuracy
NOTE: Data paper (Scientific Data). Frames extracted at 3-25 fps from 37 segments and split 80/20 at image level stratified by class (no grouping by video; leakage not discussed). Blurred footage and poor-visibility frames excluded without measurement -> P1 -> V_ALL N (also states daylight recording with 'intentional variation in light conditions and water turbidity'). Pretrained weights source not stated. Platform: handheld or positioned GoPro.
